description: This file defines models and a fetcher for SEC Litigation RSS feed data, including query parameters, data structure, and data extraction logic from SEC's RSS feed.

classes.name: SecRssLitigationQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for SEC Litigation RSS feed.

classes.name: SecRssLitigationData
classes.description: Represents the data structure for SEC Litigation RSS feed entries.

classes.name: SecRssLitigationFetcher
classes.description: Fetches and processes SEC Litigation RSS feed data.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a SecRssLitigationQueryParams instance.

methods.name: extract_data
methods.description: Fetches, cleans, parses, and returns SEC Litigation RSS feed data as a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data dictionaries into SecRssLitigationData instances.
